settings.heading: Mara Lind,
settings.text: Nine years behind the bar in two cafés, the last three training every new barista they hired. This course is what she shows them, filmed at a home machine instead of a café one.
settings.image_alt: A smiling barista in a mustard beanie holding a portafilter behind a café counter

settings.title: Where she learned
settings.text: Two busy cafés, a roastery training bar and thousands of flat whites. Write your own story here.

settings.title: How she teaches
settings.text: One idea per lesson, shown at full speed, then slowly. Every number is on screen.

settings.title: What she uses at home
settings.text: A single boiler machine, a hand grinder and a scale. Nothing you need to buy to start.

settings.heading: At a home machine,
settings.text: Every lesson was shot in a kitchen, on the kind of machine and grinder most people own. What you see is what you will get at home.
settings.image_alt: Ground coffee poured from a jar into a glass brewer on a scale, plants behind

settings.title: Short on purpose
settings.text: Most lessons are under ten minutes, so one fits before work.
